explanation: Compared against OEIS A230507 (Zhi-Wei Sun): number of ways to write n = a + b + c with a ≤ b ≤ c, where a, b, c are numbers m with 2m+1 and 2m³+1 both prime; 'Conjecture: (i) a(n) > 0 for all n > 2.' In Lean a n counts pairs x ∈ [1, n/3], y ∈ [x, (n−x)/2] with z = n − x − y (so x ≤ y ≤ z) such that the primality conditions hold for x, y, z; tests match the data (a(3) = 1, a(8) = 2). The statement a n > 0 for n > 2 is the conjecture. Faithful.
